name: Archio
summary: Warm paper-toned consultancy site with a light Crimson Pro serif, deep forest-green pill buttons and photo-pair service cards.

fonts.pairing: light 300 serif headlines with tight tracking over a neutral sans body and UI

signature: floating pill nav docked at the bottom of the hero viewport rather than the top
service cards with an icon tile, title, copy and a pair of rounded photos underneath
comparison table whose winning column has a forest-green header and tinted cells
imagery: muted documentary office and hands photography, one surreal glossy sculpture shot, warm desaturated grade
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 50px side padding, 100px section padding, 2-column card grid with 24px gutters, centered section headers
